answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money — sparingly and against verified performance — so Sybil inflation is filtered before it compounds. Tending a ocean, watching a walnut, and naming a gale is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
